Role: Head of customer success
Industry: Information Technology and Services
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I love that you can share it with other users. I use it for my personal life and for business. It keeps everything so organized and I can’t live without it now.
Cons: It is just a little learning curve learning all the different amazing ways you can use Trello. Maybe more top tips would be good.
Comments: My overall experience has been great with Trello. It was easy to sign up and share my boards with other people.it keeps me incredibly organized and has completely changed my workflows! I have my whole team sharing boards now. And all at the same time I can keep a running list of tasks for my hubby to do around the house that he can see!

Role: Manager
Industry: Marketing and Advertising
Company size: Self-employed
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Me ayuda mucho con la organización ya que soy despistada y olvido todo rápido.
Cons: Aveces necesito opciones mas avanzadas de tiempo, pero no tienen esa herramienta.
Comments: Genial, es excelente para tener tu agenda al día!

Role: Senior Researcher
Industry: Education Management
Company size: 201-500 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I like how customizable it is since we can color-code and label cards to prioritize and organize tasks based on project type. Trello’s board system is intuitive and visually organized providing us with a great overview of the whole project.
Cons: When managing very large or complex projects, Trello boards can become crowded and overwhelming.

Role: CEO
Industry: Textiles
Company size: Self-employed
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: I think all users can agree on the fact that it’s the simplicity of the main interface that makes this platform to stand out from the rest. Its features can be easily adapted to meet the needs of various projects being engaged on.
Cons: Some customization requires payment to be made before access can be granted but apart from that it has been wonderful alright.

Role: Medical biochemistry and molecular biology
Industry: Biotechnology
Company size: Self-employed
Time used: I used a free trial
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: It is very helpful when used in task management
Cons: I absolutely liked everything about Trello

Role: Project Manager
Industry: Retail
Company size: 1-10 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I like the customizable aesthetics and its user-friendly interface.
Cons: Its great for task management and project tracking, but there are limitations regarding the different ways you can organize, sort, and manipulate the data/content.
Comments: I think Trello is great! It served as the catalyst to me organizing my life and work. I’ve also enjoyed seeing the different ways my peers use Trello compared to my own personal use. I’ve used the free account options as well as the paid one.

Role: Instructional Desinger
Industry: Higher Education
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: I like the free plan, the visual Kanban boards that offer a drag-and-drop option, and Trello worked well for our project management needs.
Cons: Boards can be necessary when there is a large number of team members. I wish there were an option that allowed team members to chat synchronously.
Comments: Amazing platform for project management that offers a robust and free version plan. I also like the fact that it is user-friendly and works across different browsers and devices.

Role: National Sales Manager
Industry: Logistics and Supply Chain
Company size: 11-50 employees
Time used: 1-2 years
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 4
Pros: In your face data in a shareable format. Looks good and keeps a team on point with progress
Cons: Sometimes it feels like I am having to use double entry to populate the fields. Cut and paste helps here.
Comments: We use it with certain projects in process to keep everyone on the same page. It helps keep stuff out of the Teams atmosphere and a priority.
Reasons for switching: Separation of power on critical projects.
Switched from: Microsoft Teams

Role: Marketing Coordinator
Industry: Education Management
Company size: 5,001-10,000 employees
Time used: 2+ years
Overall rating: 5
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: Kanban boards have helped me organize mail campaigns, content for social networks, and digital advertising in general. I divide projects into progression lists so I can organize our resources according to what I need: time, money and staff. The integration with other external software is just wonderful: Slack for real-time communications and notifications, Google Drive for storage, Mailchimp for automatic campaigns, etc. Also, customizable templates save us a lot of time. And Butler simplifies repetitive tasks that I don't want to do. It's like a virtual secretary.
Cons: I know Trello is designed to be extremely simple, but I would like to be able to employ statistics to evaluate ROI.
Comments: In marketing, we require many types of employees to move a project forwards. Trello helps me communicate and manage tasks that need [truncated]

Role: Minister of Recreation
Industry: Recreational Facilities and Services
Company size: 51-200 employees
Time used: 6-12 months
Overall rating: 4
Ease-of-use rating: 5
Pros: It does what is supposed to do and keeps your workflows running. It is a good product and serves you well if that is what you need for your workspace.
Cons: Trello does a good job and I think the reason that we switched away from it was more cost
Reasons for choosing: We chose Trello initially because it had credibility and seemed to be used by other larger companies with great success.
Alternatives considered: monday.com AI Work Platform
